title: Chapter 53 Pacifying Hanzhong
content:
Chapter 53 Pacifying Hanzhong

Anyang County has a small population, only more than 10,000 people, but it has two checkpoints that are crucial to the entire Hanzhong.

That is the traffic arteries connecting Guanzhong and Yizhou, Jigu and Xiegu. Relying on the traffic arteries of these two months, Hanzhong County established Jigu Pass and Xiegu Pass.

As long as these two checkpoints are occupied, the military threats from Guanzhong in the north and Wudu County in the east can be ignored.

Using the same move, he directly used the seal of the county sheriff to open the way, and successfully deceived the city defense of the checkpoint, and easily let them be brought under his rule.

He kept 500 people at each checkpoint, and Zhong Yu took the remaining 200 people and killed the 100 people obtained by killing the two checkpoint defenders to Anyang County.

A small county town in the district was overthrown. There was no fierce resistance, and it was taken under the rule of Zhong Yu. Anyang County is relatively small, surrounded by valleys, and there are relatively few gentry.

Only killed more than 1,000 people, and did not kill after getting 50 luck points. Two hundred people were left in Anyang County, and Zhong Yu would take the remaining two hundred people to Ziwu Valley in his new Shiquan County.

This is also an important way for Unicom Hanzhong to communicate with Guanzhong. The famous Wei Yan Ziwu Valley surprise attack during the Three Kingdoms period is said to be here.

It's still the old way, using the county guard's seal to deceive the city gate, and then confiscating the defenders' ordnance. Then the massacre began, and an army of fifty men was at hand.

There are 150 people left to garrison this place, and I will definitely send him another 350 people to make up 500 people. But now he can only bring his 100 cavalry to Nanzheng County City, and then wait for a month to come, and he has enough luck to do this thing!

One month passed slowly, and the entire Hanzhong County had undergone several major cleanings by myself. The place with a population of 270,000 had become only 230,000, and he killed 40,000 of him. Extremely spicy.

I only gained 920 luck points this month. In terms of the army, there are only 1,800 of him, but it is impossible for the territory of these three counties that he has laid down to be governed by no one.

In the past two months, due to special reasons, I needed the army, so military control was implemented, but now it is no longer possible. I have already occupied the entire Hanzhong County, and I need to resume production.

Chenggu County in Hanzhong County is too large, and its eastern and southern parts are divided into Xixiang County by itself. However, the southern part of Nanzheng has no barriers and is too unsafe.

He intends to go south to occupy part of the territory of Brazil County, occupy the northern part of Hanchang County, establish a county district, and establish a Nanjiang County.

In this way, Hanzhong County will govern Anyang County, Baozhong County, Mianyang County, Nanzheng County, Xixiang County, Nanjiang County, and Chenggu County, a total of seven counties, reaching the highest number of counties in a county. The population will also reach 90,000.

In this way, I will sit on the land of three counties and nineteen counties. With so many ruling areas, there are a lot of officials needed.

A county needs about 25 officials, including 23 junior talents and two middle-level talents. To fill a county, he needs about 330 luck points.

In this world without extraordinary powers, there is definitely no need for talents who have cultivated cultural qi. I just asked the system that if those extraordinary powers were removed, the exchange price for talents would only be 1/3 of the original price.

In other words, a county only needs 110 luck points from him, which is probably enough.

It will take two months for me to completely fill these vacancies. If you add the ruling talents of the county, there will be more.

However, Hanzhong is mountainous and the transportation is inconvenient, so it is still possible to cover up the news communication for two months.

During this period of time, I just need to recuperate well and appease the civilians.

Two months passed in the blink of an eye, and the court finally realized what was wrong with Hanzhong County. Counties and counties in Guanzhong and Jingzhou informed the court of their suspicions and sent people to check.

After this period of recuperation, the Russian Central Region finally succeeded in arranging its own officials in various parts of Hanzhong, and the counties and cities also filled them in.

All the people have settled down, and they are no longer as frightened as they were at the beginning. After being governed by officials who do not corrupt or oppress people's livelihood, their reputation among those people is improving every day.

They also slowly reversed their identities as traitors, thinking that they were the teachers of justice and were saving them.

Why do you think so? Because I issued an order and announcement, that is, as long as there is a strong man in the family who comes to join the army and is successfully admitted after passing his own selection, then that family will be awarded ten acres of land on the spot.

That is a great benefit and grace. More than 90% of the land in Hanzhong County, or the whole world, is in the hands of aristocratic families, and only a small part of the land is in the hands of farmers with relatively rich family backgrounds.

I have occupied the fields of the entire gentry in Hanzhong County. It can be said that more than 90% of the people in Hanzhong County farm for themselves and are their own tenants.

Now that I am the government and their master, I could have given them whatever they wanted. But now, asking them to join an army and distribute the fields, isn't this a benevolent Mingzhu?

The three counties belonging to the whole Hanzhong were competing for joy, and the people who came to rank and join the army lined up for tens of kilometers, and more than 50,000 young and strong people came to sign up to join the army.

Of course I don't need so many soldiers, so I have absorbed a lot of unqualified people from them. Those under the age of 18 and those over the age of 40 are all excluded.

That's how it left more than 30,000 people, so we only need to eliminate some unqualified bodies, such as those with disabilities or more serious diseases. In this way, thousands of people were raised.

In this way, there were only more than 20,000 of him left. After a month of training, some of these people were eliminated one after another. In the end, only 25,000 of his soldiers remained and became a glorious soldier under his command. Soldier.

With these newly trained and strong soldiers, Zhong Yu recalled half of the ordinary soldiers who were previously distributed in various counties. These are people with war experience, and they need to stay under their command to continue fighting. How can they guard the county towns? It's a waste of time!

After some adjustments and dispatches, he recalled a total of 2,000 ordinary soldiers, and 23,000 young and strong soldiers left him, so that he has a total of 25,000 troops and can go out at any time.

The counties and counties in the direction of Jingzhou and Guanzhong found out that they were wrong, but the roads in Yizhou were even more blocked, and the news was even more blocked.

But I can take advantage of the delay in the news, catch Yizhou by surprise, attack the hinterland of Yizhou first, and open many dangerous checkpoints.

To save myself from having to go through the checkpoints one by one, not to mention the time wasted, and I don't have so many soldiers to consume.

My first goal is Wudu County, which faces Liangzhou and backs Guanzhong. Surrounded by mountains, the mountain roads are dangerous. If you control Wudu County, you can connect it with Hanzhong and completely block the connection between Yizhou and the entire northern part of Guanzhong.

At that time, Yizhou will be like a turtle in a urn. They who have lost contact with the central court will be the meat of their case and let themselves be slaughtered.
